messages:
alex: Quick check — Sherpa (sherpa-7b) onboarding status? Need license confirmation, perf profile for embeddings+generation, and a PR in models repo. target catalog launch next Wed, so need owners and blockers.
maya: I'm listed as primary owner for perf. running full 512->2048 token sweeps today. will post numbers by EOD.
prateek: I can follow up on the license with Legal. pinged @legal-bot earlier, no reply yet. any red flags on the model license (weights + tokenizer)?
samira: From curation: model metadata is mostly complete but missing training data provenance notes. I can add a short blurb but need an owner to review.
prateek: legal-bot: any update on sherpa-7b license clearance?
legal-bot: Automated: Received request for sherpa-7b license review (ticket #ML-923). Assigned to @nate. ETA 48h.
nate: On it. Skimming the T&C now — looks like permissive but need to confirm attribution. Will post summary by tomorrow morning.
maya: Perf quick note: single-GPU fp16 gen latency looks OK. embeddings shape mismatch on our pipeline though, need small preprocessing tweak from infra.
infra-bot: CI: staging inference run finished — sherpa-7b embed shape error in batch 3. See logs: https://ci.redwood/infer/98765
prateek: @alex who owns the preprocessing change? I can open a small PR if you want me to.
alex: Nate + Prateek for license + infra change. Samira to finalize metadata blurb. Maya to drop perf numbers (latency, throughput, peak mem) and recommended quant profile. I will draft catalog entry once we have those.
maya: Uploaded perf summary: https://docs.redwood/sherpa/perf-summary (short table). recommendation: q4_8-bit for embeddings, q5_6 for gen to balance latency/cost.
samira: Added provenance blurb to curation draft and assigned to @prateek for sign-off.
prateek: Quick note on PR: opened models repo PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/412 with preprocessing fix and small test. CI green locally, running full tests now.
nate: License note: permissive license, requires attribution in docs and no commercial redistribution clause. resolved — add short line to model metadata.
alex: Perfect. Remaining blockers: legal attribution line (nate), PR merge (prateek), perf table included (maya), curation sign-off (samira). Can we get all done by EOD tomorrow?
maya: EOD tomorrow for perf ok.
prateek: I can merge after CI passes — should be tomorrow AM.
nate: I'll push the license summary to the ticket and add the metadata sentence.
samira: will do final sign-off once those are in.
alex: Awesome — tagging this as: owners: perf=@maya, license=@nate, infra PR=@prateek, curation=@samira, catalog draft=@alex. If anything slips, we shift launch to Fri. Thanks all :thumbsup:
infra-bot: CI: models/pull/412 build queued.
legal-bot: Ticket ML-923 updated. status: awaiting Nate confirmation snippet.
curation: Noted the timeline — prepping final screenshots for catalog tile.
